headline: Canada Seeks LNG Export Diversification With Mid-2030s Target and Uniper Deal
summary: Canada aims to direct 55% of its natural gas exports to non-U.S. buyers by the mid-2030s, down from virtually all shipments in 2024. Germany's Uniper has signed a 20-year deal for liquefied natural gas from British Columbia.
why: Canada is one of the world's largest natural gas producers, historically reliant almost entirely on pipeline deliveries to the United States. Developing LNG terminals provides direct access to European and Asian energy markets.

impacts.name: Uniper
impacts.why: Uniper signed a 20-year agreement to purchase LNG from a planned export terminal in British Columbia.
